digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows for bridge reconciliation and deployment
propositions: Inline CAS loops and raw-git exemptions must be removed from both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows
Each workflow must invoke exactly one complete core push action with strict synchronous delivery and red-on-failure semantics
Reconciler identity, commit subject, and author metadata must be preserved through the migration to core entrypoints
Python library and MCP push defaults remain best-effort while CLI workflow adapters enforce strict delivery
Core infrastructure owns retry and CAS recovery; workflows delegate without implementing local retry loops
Test coverage must verify single push steps, absence of inline fetch/merge/retry, preserved red disposition on delivery failure, and correct author attribution
